verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents digital accounts with activity information, a Dashboard to monitor card and transaction operations, and reversals/refunds delivered through an Adjustments endpoint, which gives minimal ledger visibility. Nothing shows real-time balances, authorization-to-clearing linkage, or settlement reconciliation. Missing for 10: documented real-time account/card balances, a ledger tying each authorization to its clearing record, settlement reporting and reconciliation files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: Crea cuentas digitales y obtén información sobre sus actividades.
Monitorea toda tu operación de tarjetas, transacciones y más.
Recibirás las transacciones de tipo Reversal y Refund a través del endpoint de Ajustes.
